all.source_quote: The applicant must be a woman who has attained18 years of age.
The applicant must be a woman who has attained18 years of age.

unmodelled.text: No other LPG connection from any oil company in the same household
unmodelled.source_quote: There should be no other LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company (OMC) within the same household.

unmodelled.text: Must be from a poor household, shown by a deprivation declaration in the set format
unmodelled.source_quote: The adult woman must belong to a poor household based on submission of a deprivation declaration (as per prescribed format).

unmodelled.text: Must have a valid Aadhaar number
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant must have a valid Aadhaar number (for identificationand subsidy transfer).

unmodelled.text: Must have a bank account for DBT
unmodelled.source_quote: Must have abank account to receive subsidy through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

en.title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
en.benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection in the woman's name, with a free first refill and stove, and refill subsidy by DBT.
en.how_to_apply: Apply at an LPG distributor or online on the PMUY or oil company (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) websites, with the deprivation declaration.
